article.hook: The questions don’t stop. Neither do the rewrites. Pluto in Gemini grabs the urge to know, shape, and control what we say - and drags it deep. You’ll hear the clatter of thoughts sharpening into quiet obsessions, and the weight of words bending the air around you.
article.lived: Over two decades, this transit turns chatter into excavation. Conversations split open like cracked walls, revealing old power struggles beneath casual talk. We watch a generation dissect messages, debates, and stories - sometimes circling the same point until it fractures. Phones light up at odd hours with new angles and corrections, while curiosity becomes a tool and a trap, pulling us into webs of relentless thinking and retelling.
article.turn: The thirst for knowing mutates into control - an obsession to pin down meaning until it suffocates the moment. When every phrase is a battleground, the conversation stops being about connection and starts being about dominance. Letting go of the need to rewrite reality is the only way out of this loop.
moves: Speak with one question that doesn’t demand an answer.
